trap.label: would × used to × should have
trap.wrong: I would live in Recife, and I should have to call her.
trap.right: I used to live in Recife, and I should have called her.
trap.why: Em português “morava” e “devia ter ligado” parecem simples. Em inglês: estado antigo = used to; arrependimento = should have + particípio.

fix.right: I used to have a cat.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com used to (estado): “I had a cat.” (hábito antigo)
rewrite.answer: I used to have a cat.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com might have: “Perhaps she called.”
Reescreva sem to: “She made me to cry.”
